description: This trail starts at the parking lot on a curve along the "Diamond Head Road" also known as Ring Creek road, about 1km from Quest University. This trail was built to give riders an alternate route up the mountain, as opposed to riding on the public road. During peak season, this area sees hundreds of riders every day. The trail was built with funding from a grant provided by the Legacy Sports Society.
title: Stl'halem Sintl' Trail -Legacy Trail
